name: generate-startup-ideas
title_zh: 把创业点子从灵光一现炼成可验证机会的交互机器
tagline_zh: 受够空想？让 Codex 用几个尖锐问题、实时网页信号和你的爱/无感反馈，把模糊念头迭代成有竞品、有用户的真实机会。
tagline_en: Tired of daydreaming? Let Codex turn vague sparks into validated opportunities with sharp questions, live web.
desc_en: Generate, refine, research, and validate startup ideas through an interactive founder-specific idea machine. Use when Codex needs to ask a few focused questions, search current public web signals, rapidly brainstorm startup or SaaS ideas, learn from love/maybe/no reactions, produce additional idea rounds, compare finalists, investigate competitors and existing workarounds, select a promising oppor
why_zh: 不是一次性生成器，而是循环迭代机：用你的反馈驱动多轮产出，自动对比决赛选手、深挖竞品和替代方案。
why_en: Not a one-shot generator but an iterative engine: your feedback drives multiple rounds, auto-compares finalists, and digs into.
limit_zh: 需要 Codex 联网搜索；只覆盖点子生成与初步验证，不包含市场调研报告、财务模型或商业计划书；若你已有明确方向。
limit_en: Requires Codex web access; covers idea generation & initial validation only—no market reports, financial models, or business plans; if you have a.
